IS 18849 : 2024 Textiles - Workwear for Cement Workers - Specification
ICS 13.340.10
ICS 13.340.10
TXD 32
TXD 32
1 SCOPE
1.1 This standard specifies the test methods and minimum requirement of protective clothing to be worn during working with cement and associated activities. It covers the general clothing design, the minimum performance levels of the materials used and methods of test for determining these performance levels.
1.2 This standard does not specify the general appearance, colour, feel, etc of the cloth.
2 REFERENCES
The standards listed in Annex A contain provisions that, through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent edition of these standards.
